steps: Build the draw for an eight-team division; try to draw the second half of the season

steps: Draw a season across the NSW autumn school holidays

steps: Draw a season whose rounds cross 4 April 2027 (daylight saving ends); compare a division's first kick-off on 27 March and 10 April
expected: The same clock time (9 am stays 9 am)
actual: Round dates were p_start_at + n days on a timestamptz; in a UTC session (PostgREST) that is n × 24 hours, so every kick-off after the change was an hour earlier and the pitch fit then pushed it to the next free slot. Found by inspection while fixing the draw; the check that would have caught it is OFF7a
fixed: 0276: round dates worked out in the competition's zone

fixed: 0276: apply_reschedule resolves the ground and field to the pitch

steps: Open the game page as a family after the league moved the game to Field 3
